result.title: Comprehensive Comparisons of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms in Autonomous Driving
result.summary: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of four representative reinforcement learning (RL) methods in autonomous vehicle (AV) decision-making, including: Fitted Value Iteration (FVI), Rollout Classification Policy Iteration (RCPI), Deep Q-Network (DQN), and a discrete-action adaptation of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (D-DDPG). The four methods are applied to the same AV decision-making problem at an unsignalized intersection and are compared in terms of optimality and safety, training stability, and training and decision cost. RCPI is the closest to a reference solution and has the most stable training process. However, it is the least data-efficient. D-DDPG reaches the second-smallest gap to a reference solution with the highest data efficiency, but has the least training stability. DQN is the most stable model-free method but has the highest collision rate. FVI achieves a lower collision rate than DQN, but is less data-efficient and less stable. Based on these results, we provide suggestions for selecting a method according to whether a model is available, the budget for training, and whether stable training is required.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在无信号交叉口的自动驾驶决策任务上对比了四种强化学习算法（FVI、RCPI、DQN 及离散动作版 D-DDPG）的最优性、安全性、训练稳定性与训练/决策成本，并据此给出方法选择建议。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于自动驾驶决策中 RL 算法的通用基准比较，未涉及视觉细节保留、latent 推理状态生成或视觉证据使用，训练/数据效率与稳定性的权衡也停留在任务层面，缺少可供 LVR 核查的具体方法线索。
